description: Single-thread search before and after perf/single-thread-search under the host timing lock: per dataset, interleaved rounds of [before 4-bit, after 4-bit, after 8-bit] pinned to one CPU (taskset -c 4), 10,000 test queries per configuration, three rounds, median QPS (per-round QPS in qps_rounds). before_4bit is the v1 standing configuration (4-bit traversal codes); after_4bit runs the new code on the same index and returns the same ids for every configuration when after_4bit_results_identical_to_before is true; after_8bit is the harness wrapper default from this change. Degree 32 on every set plus degree 64 on glove-100-angular (the v1 GloVe 0.95 and 0.99 points). Two earlier attempts at the fashion-mnist and sift rounds were discarded: in the first an ann-benchmarks job outside the lock was pinned to the same CPU, in the second jobs outside the lock held the host at 1-minute load 16 to 25 and the per-configuration max/min QPS over the three rounds reached 4.6x (1.17x at most on the glove rounds). Start, end and 1-minute load of every committed set are in datasets.*.window; the host was shared with jobs outside the lock throughout, so treat ratios within the round spread as ties. The competitor columns repeat the v1 harness standing, measured at another time.

hms.build: cargo build --release --features experimental (rustc 1.99.1); build_ef 500, quantized_search, residual 8-bit, aligned rows, breadth-first order, 3-byte ids; a local driver over VGraph::searcher().search with the graph cached per (data, degree)

host.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 9 185H (WSL2, AVX2, no AVX-512)

profile_before.method: internal timers (query encoding, entry descent, adjacency+visited+prefetch issue, row estimates+pool, re-rank+sort) summed over 2,000 test queries, one thread, not pinned, host shared with other jobs; timers perturb the totals, the shares are the evidence
